import json,re
p=r"E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused2.log"
with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-16",errors="replace") as f:
    lines=f.read().splitlines()
hits=[]
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if re.search(r"(not ok|AssertionError|ERR|# fail|error:|Error:|failed)",line,re.I):
        a=max(0,i-4); b=min(len(lines),i+12)
        hits.append({"line":i+1,"context":lines[a:b]})
print(json.dumps({"line_count":len(lines),"hits":hits[-12:]},ensure_ascii=True))
